correction on a drug with no lots.note: server fabricates the ADJ- lot; the event mirrors it exactly

create_batch manual add stock.note: add_drug_to_branch at 0, then a manual lot

damage adjustment drains a lot to zero.note: FEFO draw-down across two lots; ADJ-A reaches 0

process_sale atomic emit.note: sale_created published inside the sale's transaction

receive_goods adds a second lot.note: PO receipt appending a new lot to an existing one

refund restocks the original lot.note: FEFO sale across two lots, then a refund into the exact original lot

sale_created multi-lot spill.note: 50 units across a 30 and a 70 lot; FEFO spill in batch_changes

update_batch corrects a lot.note: absolute corrected remaining_quantity, not a delta
